_readme: ONE place for AdMob IDs. Defaults are Google's public TEST ids. For release: set testing=false and paste your real ids (AdMob console -> Apps -> App settings for the App ID; Ad units for the unit IDs). android.appId is injected into AndroidManifest by android/app/build.gradle; ios.appId goes into ios/App/App/Info.plist GADApplicationIdentifier.
